newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SELLS BREWERY TO EMPLOYEES FOR $2.97 MLN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SELLS BREWERY TO EMPLOYEES FOR $2.97 MLN.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet approved on Thursday the sale of 55 percent of state-owned Plevensko pivo brewery to its staff for $2.97 million, state news agency BTA said.
The buyer, Plevensko pivo Brewery Ltd., has also pledged to invest $8 million in the brewery over the next five years.
Under the deal the buyer is to pay half of the price in cash and the other half in government securities on the day of signing the contract.
BTA quoted Privatisation Agency executive director Alexander Sabotinov as saying that the sell-off contract for the Pleven-based brewerey would be signed within several days.
